gates.name: Open for Business
gates.text: D-list cast and directors. Horror, Comedy, Drama and Horror-Comedy.

gates.name: Real Directors
gates.text: C-list directors, plus Thriller, Romance and Rom-Com.

gates.name: Major Player
gates.text: B-list cast and directors, plus Action, Sci-Fi and their blends.

gates.name: A-List Studio
gates.text: A-list cast and directors, Animation, and real release dates on any project.

badges.name: First Hit
badges.text: Make a profit on a film.

badges.name: Sleeper Hit
badges.text: Earn $15M profit while spending at most 60% of the budget.

badges.name: Reunion
badges.text: Reunite a director with an actor they have made films with.

badges.name: Comeback
badges.text: Make a hit right after a flop.

badges.name: Genre Master
badges.text: Three profitable films in one genre. That genre earns +3% at the box office from then on.

badges.name: Full House
badges.text: Make a hit with only D-list talent after C-list actors unlock.

badges.name: Perfect Timing
badges.text: Release in a window the story suits.
